problem_it_solves: Phone running slow and storage full
step_by_step: 1. Go to Settings 2. Apps 3. Select app 4. Storage 5. Clear Cache
why_it_works: Cache builds up and slows phone - clearing frees space and speed
pakistan_context: Budget phones have limited storage - this is free speed boost

problem_it_solves: Apps using too much data and battery
step_by_step: 1. Uninstall Facebook 2. Install Facebook Lite 3. Same for other apps
why_it_works: Lite apps use 50-70% less data and battery
pakistan_context: Data packages are expensive - save money with lite apps

problem_it_solves: Can't watch videos due to slow data
step_by_step: 1. Connect to WiFi 2. Open YouTube 3. Tap download button 4. Watch offline anytime
why_it_works: WiFi usually faster - download when free then watch anywhere
pakistan_context: Use office/cafe WiFi to download - watch at home

step_by_step: 1. Settings 2. Network 3. Data Saver 4. Turn ON
why_it_works: Compresses data and blocks background usage
pakistan_context: 1GB package will last longer - save money

problem_it_solves: Hard to take notes while watching tutorial
step_by_step: 1. Open YouTube 2. Recent apps 3. Hold app icon 4. Split top 5. Open Notes in bottom
why_it_works: Watch tutorial and take notes simultaneously
pakistan_context: Perfect for mobile learners - no laptop needed

problem_it_solves: Typing common phrases takes too long
step_by_step: 1. Settings 2. Language & Input 3. Personal dictionary 4. Add shortcuts like 'em' for email
why_it_works: Type abbreviation and it expands to full text
pakistan_context: Freelancers can reply faster to clients

step_by_step: 1. Ctrl+Shift+Esc 2. Startup tab 3. Disable unnecessary apps 4. Restart
why_it_works: Fewer programs at startup means faster boot

problem_it_solves: Too many windows open gets confusing
step_by_step: 1. Win+Tab 2. New Desktop 3. Organize work on different desktops 4. Swipe to switch
why_it_works: Keep work browser and personal browser separate
pakistan_context: Great for focus - separate work and personal

step_by_step: Ctrl+C copy|Ctrl+V paste|Ctrl+Z undo|Ctrl+S save|Alt+Tab switch|Win+D desktop
why_it_works: 10x faster than mouse for common actions
pakistan_context: Every second saved adds up - more productive freelancing

step_by_step: 1. Right-click tab 2. 'Send to group' 3. Color code groups 4. Collapse when not needed
why_it_works: Organized tabs use less memory and easier to find

step_by_step: 1. Turn off laptop 2. Use compressed air or soft brush 3. Clean vents 4. Do monthly
pakistan_context: Pakistan dust + heat = laptop killer - prevention is key

problem_it_solves: Old laptop too slow to use
step_by_step: 1. Buy 240GB SSD (around 6000 PKR) 2. Clone or fresh install Windows 3. 5x faster laptop
pakistan_context: Best upgrade for old laptops - like new computer

step_by_step: 1. Buy 1000VA UPS (15-20K PKR) 2. Connect computer 3. Get 30-60 min backup
why_it_works: Saves work during sudden power cuts
pakistan_context: Load shedding reality - UPS is investment not expense

step_by_step: 1. Connect phone to WiFi 2. Enable hotspot 3. Connect laptop to hotspot
pakistan_context: Avoid buying expensive extender - use old phone

step_by_step: 1. Buy basic USB keyboard (1500-3000 PKR) 2. Plug in 3. Better typing experience
why_it_works: Proper keyboard reduces strain and increases speed

why_it_works: Browser versions use less storage and work same
